implemented: Privacy defaults and a main-process diagnostics manifest exclude note content, provider secrets and absolute paths; the renderer exposes the local-only diagnostics control and PRIVACY.md documents safe-mode and extension-bisect handoffs.

limitations: Screen-reader, visible focus, contrast/scale, IME/popout and cross-platform interaction traces still require a launched Electron runtime and human review.
